delete.impact: {count} service(s) will be left without a category.

packages.loadError: The packages could not be loaded.

form.name: Name
form.percentInvalid: Type a percentage from 0 to 100, with at most two decimals.
form.fixedPriceHelp: Leave empty to price it as the sum of its lines minus the discount.
form.validityHelp: Days redeemable from the purchase; empty = never expires.
form.usesHelp: Uses the voucher grants; empty = unlimited.
form.linesFixed: The services included cannot be changed once created: delete this package and create a new one.
form.noLines: Add at least one service: a package with no lines cannot be redeemed.

delete.title: Delete package
delete.message: {name} — the package and its {count} line(s) leave the catalogue and can no longer be sold; vouchers already sold can still be spent, and you find them filtering Status by Deleted.

grants.title: Sold vouchers
grants.hint: Every customer who bought this voucher, with the sessions used and left. A live voucher can get extra sessions or a later expiry as a courtesy, or have sessions removed to correct its balance; a sale nothing was used from can be voided.
grants.empty: Nobody has bought this voucher yet.
grants.error: Could not load the sold vouchers

void.title: Void this voucher?
void.message: The voucher of customer {customer} ({amount}) stops being usable and stays in the list as voided. The money is not given back here: if it was paid, refund the sale from Sales with a return.
void.reasonHelp: Required. It stays on the voucher's record, e.g. «sold to the wrong customer».

adjust.title: Adjust this voucher
adjust.message: Give customer {customer} extra sessions or a later expiry at no charge, or remove sessions to correct the balance. It is recorded in the voucher's movements with who, when and why.
adjust.usesRemoveHelp: {remaining} left now. You can remove up to {remaining}.
adjust.reasonHelp: Required. It stays on the voucher's record, e.g. «we were closed in August».
adjust.previewUnlimited: After the adjustment: no session limit · {expiry}

movements.title: Voucher movements
movements.hint: Every session of this voucher spent, plus the courtesies given and the corrections made afterwards.
movements.empty: This voucher has not been used yet.

orphans.title: Vouchers with no customer
orphans.hint: Their customer card was deleted or anonymised. The voucher keeps everything it was sold with: to give the money back, find the sale in Sales; to void it if it was not used, open it from Sold vouchers.
orphans.empty: No voucher has lost its customer.
orphans.error: The vouchers with no customer could not be loaded.
